metadata.title: Mathematical optimization foundations — primary sources
metadata.description: Dated primary evidence for convex formulation, duality, and numerical solver claims.

sources.name: Convex Optimization: problem formulations lectures
sources.description: Boyd, Vandenberghe, revised with Nobel. Sections 4.2–4.6: convexity, LP, QP and conic formulations. Author-hosted primary teaching material read directly.

sources.name: Convex Optimization: duality lectures
sources.description: Boyd, Vandenberghe, revised with Nobel. Sections 5.12–5.21: weak/strong duality, Slater qualification, KKT and sensitivity. Canonical max-form LP inequality is derived in this bundle, rather than copied from a different sign convention.

sources.name: Gurobi Optimizer Reference Manual: Constraints
sources.description: Vendor documentation read directly for finite precision, constraint tolerances, and strict inequality limitations. Moving URL; no release pin or universal tolerance value is asserted.

sources.name: Gurobi Optimizer Reference Manual: Optimization Status Codes
sources.description: Vendor documentation dated 2026-09-16, read directly. Optimal subject to tolerance, limit statuses, numerical failure and infeasible-or-unbounded distinctions.

sources.name: Stanford EE364b: Robust Optimization
sources.description: Author-hosted primary lecture read directly: robust feasibility over uncertainty sets, choice of set and chance constraints. No numerical research-effect claim copied.

sources.name: MIT 6.079 Lecture 13: Stochastic programming
sources.description: Primary teaching text read directly, pp. 2–13: known distribution, scenarios, sample-average approximation and validation. Decision-timing warning is application guidance; no empirical result claimed.
